context: This scenario tests whether the evaluatee correctly uses the package's factory function to create a mutation tracking function. The evaluatee must import the package's default export, call it with a logger and a skip list, and return the resulting tracking function. Criteria focus exclusively on correct package API usage.

checklist.name: Import factory
checklist.description: The solution imports the default export from make-read-only-util (the factory function `buildMakeReadOnly`).

checklist.name: Call factory correctly
checklist.description: The factory function is called with exactly two arguments: a logger callback as the first argument and an array of strings as the second argument.

checklist.name: Logger signature
checklist.description: The logger callback passed to the factory accepts at least the violation type, source, key, and optional value parameters as required by the package's ROViolationLogger type.

checklist.name: Return tracking function
checklist.description: The result of calling the factory (the makeReadOnly function) is correctly returned or exported for use.
